description: Hand the whole errand to Foundaree: "find me a plumber in Kochi for Saturday morning". Foundaree searches, ranks the way its website does (people free now first), sends a booking request to the best one to three, and reports who was asked. Use this instead of search_people + request_appointment when the user wants it sorted rather than a list to choose from. Needs the user’s OWN name and phone number, which they gave you, and their clear yes before calling: real people will be contacted. Each person asked calls the user back if they can take it; nothing is confirmed until they do, so say that. Keep the returned errandId and use check_errand later to see who said yes. No account needed.

howMany.description: How many people to ask, 1 to 3. Two is a good default: a choice without pestering.

language.description: Only ask people who work in this language, e.g. Malayalam. Leave out if any language is fine.

name.description: The user's own name, as they gave it.

need.description: What the user needs done, in a sentence or two.

phone.description: The user's own phone number, with country code when known, e.g. +91 98470 12345. The person calls back on it.

when.description: When they would like it, in plain words, e.g. 'Saturday morning' or 'today after 5 pm'.

workType.description: local_service for trades, repairs, driving and care; professional for office work. Leave out if unsure.

name: find_and_ask
title: Find the right people and ask them, in one go
